title: Integrating forest cover change and carbon storage dynamics: Leveraging Google Earth Engine and InVEST model to inform conservation in hilly regions
study_area: Chittagong Hill Tracts region (Chittagong, Cox's Bazar, Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachari districts)
methods: maximum likelihood classification in Google Earth Engine
InVEST carbon storage and sequestration model
key_result: From 1996 to 2021 vegetation fell by 2862.86 km2 (21%) and carbon storage fell from 495.93 x 10^6 Mg to 479.63 x 10^6 Mg, with Chittagong losing the most (7.99 x 10^6 Mg).

method_details.classifier: maximum likelihood supervised classification in Google Earth Engine
method_details.accuracy: more than 500 random points per year from Google Earth; kappa 90.18, 91.85, 92.63, 93.66, 93.57, 93.32 (1996 to 2021)
method_details.carbon_formula: C = sum over classes m of A_m * (C_m,a + C_m,b + C_m,s + C_m,d)
method_details.sequestration_formula: S = C(T2) - C(T1), T2 > T1, pixel by pixel

carbon_pools_mg_per_ha_derived.note: derived by dividing the printed Mg/km2 values by 100; not printed in the paper

method_details.emission_calculation: Carbon loss = difference in total InVEST carbon storage between years (S = C(T2) - C(T1)); summed per district for gain-loss
method_details.regression: multiple linear regression of carbon storage on precipitation (BMD), NDVI, EVI and elevation (DEM); results in supplementary Table S3
